svg.title: Relay allocation loop
svg.desc: Relay allocation with direct default-account and subaccount-one funding, split-routing subaccounts 10 through 90, the Jupiter Faucet, managed-canister cycles top-ups and observed cycles balances, and configured surplus recipients.
svg.text: select one; each deposit divides between both destinations
